definitions.explanation: A polite or neutral way to refer to an adult male.

examples.japanese: あの{男|おとこ}の{人|ひと}は{誰|だれ}ですか。
{駅|えき}で{男|おとこ}の{人|ひと}に{道|みち}を{聞|き}かれた。
examples.english: A man asked me for directions at the station.

examples.japanese: {背|せ}の{高|たか}い{男|おとこ}の{人|ひと}が{入|はい}ってきた。

notes:
{男|おとこ}の{人|ひと} is the polite, neutral way to say 'man' in Japanese, commonly used when referring to or describing men you don't know personally.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {男|おとこ}: man (slightly more direct/casual)
- {男性|だんせい}: male (formal, often used in official contexts)
- {紳士|しんし}: gentleman (formal, respectful)

The opposite term is {女|おんな}の{人|ひと} (woman).
